verdict.rationale: Stagehand documents a user-data directory that persists across browser shutdowns, so later runs start with the same cookies and local storage. For Browserbase sessions, it uses contexts to persist browser data, which directly enables skipping logins on reuse. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of named or reusable profile management across multiple agents, any login-specific guidance, and independent or hands-on corroboration that sessions stay authenticated.
